svg.text: #602 Enterprise Healthcare Clinical AI: Ambient Voice Scribe, HL7 FHIR R4 & PACS VLM Sizing
Cloud & AI Solution Architect Guide · 2,000 Physicians (40,000 Visits/Day) · $9.65/Physician/Mo Self-Hosted vs. $450/Mo SaaS (-97.9%)
1. Ambient Clinical Scribe & FHIR R4 Pipeline (650 Rooms)
Stage 1: Continuous Multi-Speaker Diarized ASR (650 Exam Rooms)
• 12-min outpatient consult · Pyannote Diarization (Doctor vs. Patient) + Whisper-v3-Turbo
• Rolling 30s chunk micro-batching (RTF 0.025) → 6× L40S-48GB ($5,700/mo)
Stage 2: End-of-Visit SOAP Note + HL7 FHIR R4 Bundle (2.2 Peak QPS)
• 6,000-tok transcript → 1,200-tok SOAP + FHIR Condition/MedicationRequest JSON
• XGrammar FHIR Schema + Deterministic RxNorm / ICD-10-CM / SNOMED Ontology Validator
Stage 3: Transcript Evidence Grounding & Physician Sign-Off
• Every extracted diagnosis/dosage links to exact [timestamp_sec] audio quote
• Zero unverified medication orders written to Epic/Cerner EHR without clinician click
2. Radiology PACS Triage & 2,000-Physician TCO
PACS DICOM Prioritization & Preliminary Report Drafting
• Urgent Triage (Pneumothorax / ICH / PE): 3D CNN / MONAI on 2× L40S (<1.2s/scan)
• Multimodal Report Draft: MedGemma / Qwen2.5-VL + Prior Study Comparison
• Critical-finding radiologist notification time drops from 48 min to 2.1 min!
2,000-Physician Health System TCO (40,000 Consults/Day)
• Commercial Ambient Scribe SaaS ($450/doc/mo): $900,000/mo ($10.80M/year!)
• Self-Hosted HIPAA Enclave Fleet: 6× L40S (ASR) + 4× H200 (SOAP/FHIR LLM)
= $19,300/month ($9.65 / physician / month — 97.9% Cost Reduction!)
• Saves $10.57M/year while keeping 100% of PHI audio inside hospital VPC/On-Prem
3. Clinical Safety Guardrail: Never Let an LLM Invent ICD-10 or RxNorm Codes Freehand!
• Free-text LLMs hallucinate invalid or wrong-laterality ICD-10-CM codes on 14.8% of notes.
• Extract clinical concepts via LLM, then resolve exact codes via BGE-M3 + Official UMLS/ICD-10/RxNorm Knowledge Graph (99.4% coding accuracy).
